def forward(self, x, dynamic_coefficient, dynamic_flag=False):
    first = self.blend(x)
    second = self.blend(x, coefficient=0.75, inspected=True)
    third = self.blend(x, dynamic_coefficient, inspected=dynamic_flag)
    return first + second + third
